_comment: Learning objectives contributed by the javascript-foundations pack. The seven objectives of the platform's javascript track (javascript-web-javascript-guide-*, content-packs/curriculum.json) cover the MDN guide chapters the javascript pack ingests and are reused directly in step front matter - they are NOT redefined here. The objectives below cover what this course teaches beyond that pack. Their sourceDocIds name the MDN guide pages reproduced under this pack's sources/ (CC-BY-SA 2.5, Mozilla and individual contributors) and the workspace files a student actually reads, in the same style as the cads-zero-foundations pack.

objectives.statement: Student can run Node's built-in test runner on a single file or a whole workspace, read the assertion diff it prints, and tell a module that failed to load from a test that failed an assertion.
Student can export named and default bindings from an ES module, import them from another file, and read the SyntaxError Node raises for a missing export.
Student can define an error class that extends Error, carries a name and extra fields, and survives instanceof checks, and can decide when a caller benefits from it over a plain Error.
Student can create and consume promises, express the same flow with async/await, and explain why a value is a Promise until it is awaited.
Student can diagnose why a try/catch around an un-awaited call never fires, and can wrap a rejection in a new error without losing the original as its cause.
Student can judge when work should run sequentially and when concurrently, and can choose between Promise.all and Promise.allSettled by what the caller must learn about partial failure.
